Name: Bog's Halloween Pumpkin Crop
Author: BogWyytch
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/D0ScKVyC/retro-bookcase.png[/img]
As Aba and I are very hard at work deep in the mines working to create the companion mod to Monster Mash..... Monster Husbandry, we took a small break to release a simple pumpkin crop replacement! We hope you all are enjoying this very creepy crawly fall season in whatever way you celebrate.

These pumpkins were inspired off my my IRL garden. This year, while i have been almost completely housebound due to illness﻿, I grew pumpkins in my yard IRL. I have always loved pumpkins but to grow my very own, it was such a wonderful special and magical process. So to celebrate my own joy i now bring that joy to you!

Yes, do not fret this DOES INDEED MEAN i will be doing my own retextures of all of the seed bags, seeds, growing crops, giant crops and the crop produce. DO NOT EXPECT THIS ANYTIME SOON. My ADHD rules my life and i will be working on those sprites in the background of other projects. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/nhhq8bRZ/retro-bookcase-1.png[/img]

[center]See this mod, the entire Bogwood Collection and more in my new youtube series Murkwood Grove!
[youtube]hfF1DBlFluA[/youtube][/center]

I am working on the entire BOGGIFICATION of the valley.

This means that every vanilla texture will one day be completely redone in my style! But this is a long term project. If you would like to see sneak peaks on what Aba and I are working on....
